el_profile.checked: every constructor of every axiom in the written .ofn against the OWL 2 EL grammar (whitelist); flags inverse properties, universal restrictions, negation, disjunction, cardinality, functional/symmetric/asymmetric/irreflexive properties and enumerations of more than one element

rbox_regularity.note: OWL 2 spec section 11.2; no inverse property expressions occur, so INV(X) is ordered like X
